page.title: Focus
page.purpose: Host a durable working session — Pomodoro, countdown, open, or untimed — centered on the session objective, with interruption capture and a wrap-up that records real effort without asserting timer time is task completion.

priorities.statement: The focused view centers objective, timer/mode, next step, source link, next stop time, and pause/end; navigation recedes but stays accessible.
Timer digits render from a confirmed server timestamp, not client heartbeat; refresh, tab suspension, and process restart never reset a session.
Wrap-up offers Done / More to do / Blocked with optional remaining effort and notes — all feedback is genuinely optional; ending a work interval never completes the task.
A gentle stopping cue appears before the next fixed obligation; extending the timer never moves the appointment.

states.description: The current authoritative session and its revision resolve on entry/reconnect.
No active session: Start focus is available from a task, spontaneously, or via quick start.
Opened without a task: spontaneous work can be recorded and classified later.
A forgotten/overlong session is flagged for correction rather than confidently assigned many hours.
A displayed elapsed time drifted from server time and is reconciled against the authoritative timestamp.
An exclusive session is running; the current work segment is open and its elapsed time renders from the server timestamp.
Wrap-up recorded: actuals and provenance saved; remaining effort independently editable.
Another current exclusive session exists (possibly another device): offer Continue, End, or Switch through a revision-checked command, never a duplicate counter.
Disconnected: the timer keeps rendering from the last confirmed timestamp; pause/finish are retained as pending local corrections, marked clearly.
A transition failed: show the failure and the current authoritative session state; never hide failure behind an optimistic timer.
